brief: Epiphany commemorates the revelation of Christ to the Gentiles, particularly in the persons of the wise men from the east. The story reflects the church’s major mission to the Gentiles. Like Balaam of old, these astrologers had seen the rising messianic star; the Jewish Scriptures (through Herod) led them to the place of the Jewish king’s birth at Bethlehem. These Scriptures are fulfilled further in their gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh. They have also suggested that they were three kings who came first to worship our king.
